accountKey.title: Account
accountKey.summary: Export or import your account key and switch between accounts.
accountKey.scopeNotice: This covers only the account key that represents who you are. It does not include a full backup of your posts, settings, attachments, or private channel secrets — full device migration is planned separately.

export.title: Export account key
export.warning: Anyone who obtains this export and its passphrase can fully impersonate you. If you forget the passphrase, no one — including the operators — can recover it. Store it only in a safe place.

distanceOptout.title: Distance opt-out
distanceOptout.notEligible: Distance opt-out is unavailable for this node (authentication, required consent, connectivity, or index/trust provision is missing).
distanceOptout.description: When enabled, this node mutually suppresses surfacing between you and users beyond its displayed proximity boundary, helping avoid large-scale conflict amplification between distant communities.
distanceOptout.notPrivacy: This is reversible node-local display control. It is not a privacy feature, block, graph departure, P2P restriction, or network-wide invisibility guarantee.
distanceOptout.notLoaded: Load the current setting and node-local boundary before changing it.

reasons.INVITE_REQUIRED: This node requires an invite code to join.
reasons.INVITE_INVALID: The invite code is not valid.
reasons.INVITE_EXHAUSTED: The invite code has reached its usage limit.
reasons.INVITE_REVOKED: The invite code has been revoked.
reasons.NOT_ALLOWLISTED: This node only admits accounts on its allowlist.
reasons.BANNED: This node has stopped providing support services to this account. This is not a network-wide ban.

nextSteps.INVITE_REQUIRED: Enter an invite code and authenticate again.
nextSteps.INVITE_INVALID: Check the code or obtain a new invite code and enter it.
nextSteps.INVITE_EXPIRED: Obtain a new invite code from the node operator.
nextSteps.INVITE_EXHAUSTED: Obtain an available invite code from the node operator.
nextSteps.INVITE_REVOKED: Obtain a new invite code from the node operator.
nextSteps.NOT_ALLOWLISTED: Ask the node operator to add your account to the allowlist.
nextSteps.BANNED: Contact this node's operator if needed. Automatic retries are stopped.

adultContent.label: Show media and posts self-labeled as adult material
adultContent.description: While this is off, kukuri does not download or display media attached to posts that were self-labeled as adult material, and shows a placeholder instead. Labels are self-declared by the people who post; an unlabeled post is not guaranteed to be free of adult material. This preference is stored only on this device and is separate from the age self-attestation.
